item.title: Pearl Bead and Stone Trim Collection
item.description:
Pearl Bead and Stone Trim Collection (item 2601027) is developed for apparel brands, importers and trim wholesalers. As a one-stop garment accessories platform we confirm size, color, finish and packing against an approved sample. Reference material: Glass pearl, resin stone, mesh. Final composition, plating, dimension and inspection are locked after sampling. Typical use: ready-to-wear, knitwear, bridal, scarves and private-label programs.

For a quote send item number, quantity, color or plating, end use and destination. Sampling is handled in Guangzhou. Browse Pearl & Bead Trims or request a written offer.
